description: Casualty losses, both regimes at once (mirrors TaxCalcBench ty25-us-002): HoH, AGI 33,650 (wages 32,000 + other income 1,650). Standard side: 23,625 HoH + 2,500 qualified-disaster ADD (4684 instructions: deductible without itemizing) = 26,125.
